## In-Class Agenda

- [ ] Introductions and goals for the course
- [ ] Overview and review the syllabus, slides available [here](../slides/01-introducing-culture-as-data.qmd)
- [ ] Discuss and define "What is computing in the humanities?" versus "What is culture as data?"
  - Visit [What is Digital Humanities?](https://whatisdigitalhumanities.com/) and refresh a few times
  - Also visit [Open Syllabus Project](https://opensyllabus.org/)
- [ ] Start survey for group assignments (time permitting) available on Canvas
- [ ] Start lesson on [Course Tools](../materials/introducing-defining-cad/01-CAD-tools.qmd)
